expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is offset vertically compared to 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccolo' — its image starts lower and its title/delivery-fee text sits lower than the neighboring cards, breaking row alignment.
